messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: autoscaler-high-error-rate in eu-west-1 -> impact: inference queue growth, degraded tail latency. Paging rotation: @elaine, escalation: @mike. Join #incidents-bridge if available.
elaine: on it, joining bridge now. pulling metrics from grafana.
elaine: grafana link: https://grafana.redwood/eu-west/autoscale — seeing scale events every ~30s, pods flapping, GPU allocation errors (OOM-ish).
mike: same. qps hasn't spiked; looks like scheduler failing to bind GPU nodes during scale up. errors: "InsufficientGPU: requested 1, available 0"
jess: FYI CS has a customer report of slow generation for a revenue-critical batch job in eu-west. Carla, can you confirm scope of customers affected?
carla-cs: Two paid customers reported timeouts from 12:07 -> 12:22 UTC, lots of retries. I'm collecting request ids now.
sam: adding context — we deployed autoscaler tune last night (scale-down aggressive). Could be related.
elaine: on bridge. running `kubectl describe hpa -n inference` and `kubectl get nodes -o wide`. paste logs.
elaine: logs: ```2026-02-17T12:06:48Z kube-scheduler: FailedScheduling InsufficientGPU for pod/predictor-562
2026-02-17T12:07:05Z autoscaler: launched scale-up, then error: attach-volume timeout``` 
mike: hypothesis: thin provision pool exhausted in eu-west; provisioner returning capacity but nodes not ready before scheduler binds.
ops-bot: AUTO-ANNOTATION: region=eu-west cluster=inference-eu-west, incident_id=INC-2003456789
jess: customer impact: high for two customers, degraded for a small percentage of hosted API calls in eu-west. We'll run hotfix route: route traffic to eu-central fallback for affected customers if they have fallback enabled.
carla-cs: requesting rollback window? Customers asking ETA. We need timeline.
elaine: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily increase burst capacity by applying pre-provisioned pool (kube label: gpu-reserved=high) 2) patch autoscaler to add wait-for-node-ready before bind 3) route critical customers to eu-central for 20m
mike: doing step 1 now: `kubectl label nodes --selector=role=gpu spare=true --overwrite gpu-reserved=high` then scale replica set `kubectl scale rs/gpu-pool-spare --replicas=6 -n infra`
mike: spare pool scaled to 6, starting node join. ETA ~90s.
elaine: I see nodes Join and Ready. Re-running failing pods. pods now scheduling and GPU attach success.
ops-bot: METRIC: queue-length eu-west inference dropped from 420 -> 60 over 3m.
carla-cs: customers report improved latency. One still had a retry spike around 12:13 but now OK.
sam: pushing a quick autoscaler change to add a 15s backoff and readiness-check hook. I'll open PR but we may hotpatch via k8s job first.
jess: approve routing to eu-central for impacted customers until patch is live. I'll add temporary rule in routing-config: `route_override: {region: eu-central, selector: customer in [custA, custB]}`
elaine: good. capturing timeline: incident start 2003456789, mitigation applied 2003456925 (spare pool), route overrides 2003457000, autoscaler patch applied 2003457250.
mike: note: cluster logs show attach-volume timeouts from CSI plugin; filing ticket with infra-provisioner.
carla-cs: CS will follow up with customers for incident summary + ETA for permanent fix.
ops-bot: ACTION-ITEM CREATED: ACTION-4521 assign=cap-ops title="Investigate CSI attach-volume timeouts in eu-west" due=2026-02-19
ops-bot: ACTION-4522 assign=eng-runtime title="Add node-ready gating to autoscaler" due=2026-02-18
ops-bot: ACTION-4523 assign=eng-sre title="Provision spare GPU pool SLA and playbook" due=2026-02-20
sam: I'll draft a post-incident review. Can we schedule a 30m PIR tomorrow 09:30 UTC? attendees: eng-sre, eng-runtime, cap-ops, CS, product.
jess: 09:30 works for me. adding to calendar.
elaine: quick RCA notes: root cause likely combo of aggressive scale-down + CSI attach delays -> temporary zero available GPUs -> scheduler fails. Remediation: change scale-down policy, add node-ready gating, improve KMS/CSI retry logic, maintain small warm pool.
mike: proposed rollback if similar spike reappears: immediate fallback routing + scale-out of spare pool automated via runbook.
carla-cs: for customer comms: I'll send interim note with timeline and our mitigation; final postmortem after PIR.
ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, impact=partial (2 paid customers), duration~18m. incident_id=INC-2003456789
elaine: closing bridge. leaving action items in tracker. Thanks all :thumbsup:
carla-cs: tagging legal for any required notices. filing support follow-up ticket with request ids.
sam: PIR invite sent. Agenda: timeline, root cause, short-term mitigations, permanent fixes, test plan for CSI/attach scenarios.
jess: added regression test to CI: simulate delayed node readiness and ensure autoscaler waits. PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/3482
mike: I'll own ACTION-4522 and work with cap-ops on ACTION-4521. ETA for autoscaler gating patch to staging: EOD tomorrow.
elaine: recorded notes and uploaded logs to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/incidents/INC-2003456789
ops-bot: REMINDER: ACTION-4521 is due in 48h."
